reason: The cited evidence confirms the alloy can be made amorphous by melt-spinning (E1, E2) and that slower cooling leads to crystallization (E1, E3), but it provides no data on reheating behavior, crystallization temperatures during reheating, or the effect of ultra-rapid heating on this alloy. The specific temperature window and the mechanism of kinetic stabilization by flash annealing are unsupported by the cited passages.
